crossRefs.note: All these were the rulers of the property which was king David’s.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hagri
people.line: A Gadite, father of Mibhar, one of David's mighty men.

people.name: Jaziz
people.line: Hagrite in charge of David's flocks

translations.web: All these were the rulers of the property which was king David’s.
translations.bsb: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks. All these officials were in charge of King David’s property.
translations.kjv: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
translations.asv: All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David's.
